summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests ivonescimab in people with advanced or unresectable leiomyosarcoma who have had previous treatment. Ivonescimab is given intravenously (IV) every 3 weeks on Day 1 of each cycle, for up to 24 months in total. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record says the study aims to learn whether the treatment is effective and safe, with few or mild side effects.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa ivonescimab en personas con leiomiosarcoma avanzado o no resecable que ya recibieron tratamiento previo. Ivonescimab se administra por vena (IV) cada 3 semanas, el día 1 de cada ciclo, durante un máximo de 24 meses en total. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; el registro señala que el estudio busca saber si el tratamiento es eficaz y seguro, con efectos secundarios leves o pocos.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with unresectable or metastatic leiomyosarcoma confirmed by biopsy.
Between 1 and 3 prior lines of systemic therapy for leiomyosarcoma.
Blood, kidney, liver and clotting test values within the stated limits.
not_for: Prior anti-PD1, PD-L1, or VEGF inhibitor therapy.
Symptomatic autoimmune disease, or autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Major surgery or serious trauma within 4 weeks before randomization.
Recent bleeding problems, or poorly controlled high blood pressure.
Symptomatic brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
